PRISM HEIST

HIGH-SECURITY OPTIC ROUTING & STEALTH PUZZLE

Infiltrate five fortified museum vaults across an expanded 16×10 tactical grid. Drag and drop precision deflection mirrors from your equipment bay onto the vault floor, boost beam range through Amplifier Prisms, evade sweeping CCTV surveillance cones, and strike the target diamond before lockdown expires.

LIVE TELEMETRY // VAULT CAMERA FEED
DRAG-AND-DROP OPTIC ROUTING

Drag / or \ mirrors directly from the Tactical Equipment Dock onto any unmonitored floor tile, or drag placed mirrors across the grid to recalibrate your trajectory.

01 // DRAG & DROP MIRRORS

Drag mirrors from the bottom dock onto the 16×10 grid, or drag placed mirrors to reposition them.

02 // CCTV CONE LOCKOUT

Tiles swept by amber CCTV cones are locked. Wait for the camera to sweep past before dropping.

03 // AMPLIFIER PRISMS

Laser beams decay over distance. Route through magenta Amplifier Prisms to boost range (+10/+12).

04 // PHOTO-SENSOR TRAPS

Striking a red photo-sensor triggers an immediate lockdown alarm. Route cleanly around hazards.

SPRITE & AUDIO ASSET MANIFEST

All required sprites and synthesized WAV audio files are pre-packaged inside your Vercel deployment bundle under /assets/sprites/ and /assets/audio/. Drop custom PNGs or WAV/MP3 files with the exact filenames below to hot-swap art or sound effects.

/assets/sprites/ (64x64 PNG)
  • floor.png — Dark vault slate tile
  • wall.png — Reinforced obsidian barrier
  • emitter.png — Laser source turret
  • diamond.png — Target vault diamond
  • mirror_slash.png — 45° deflector (/)
  • mirror_backslash.png — 135° deflector (\)
  • sensor.png — Photo-sensor alarm node
  • cctv.png — Sweeping surveillance camera
  • booster.png — Range amplifier prism
/assets/audio/ (WAV / MP3)
  • bgm_heist.wav — Ambient espionage synth loop
  • sfx_place.wav — Mirror magnetic lock click
  • sfx_rotate.wav — Servo rotation chime
  • sfx_laser.wav — High-energy optic discharge
  • sfx_win.wav — Vault extraction chord
  • sfx_alarm.wav — Security breach siren
  • sfx_tick.wav — Final 10s lockdown pulse
